title: Verify: validateWorld scene character reference unit tests
summary: Unit tests for scene character validation.
description: Add tests in game/tests/validator.test.ts using in-memory fixtures from tests/fixtures/valid-world.ts, with no filesystem or network.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown scene character id yields the exact path-tagged error
Valid and absent scene characters yield no character error
technical_constraints: Fixtures come from game/tests/fixtures/valid-world.ts (WorldDef/SceneDef types in game/src/state/types.ts)

steps.action: Add a describe block with three tests built from validWorld and validScene: (1) validScene plus characters [boy, ghost] (position {x:0,y:0}, animations.idle {asset:'character:boy',animation:'idle'}) expects errors toContain 'scenes.bedroom.characters.1.id: unknown character: ghost'; (2) scene with characters [boy] expects no error containing 'characters.'; (3) scene without characters expects errors toEqual [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in validator.test.ts pass, including the three new ones
